integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide documentary shot frames a solitary puffin tottering over a drifting sheet of sea ice under pale polar light, its head cocking with curious-but-wary little movements. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed as, beneath the clear frozen surface, a dark streamlined figure slips past — a hungry orca circling below the translucent ice. [Shot 2] At 00:02.500, the shot cuts to a low close angle as the puffin stiffens, then throws itself forward and skims across the ice on its chest, flippers scrabbling, while the orca smashes up through the frozen layer just behind it, shattering plates and erupting spray and ice shards, jaws lunging open. [Shot 3] At 00:04.500, right before the killer whale can snap its mouth shut, an immense silhouette sweeps across the white landscape, plunging the scene into momentary shadow; the camera tilts upward with a single deliberate motion to uncover a colossal wyvern diving out of the churning thunderhead, its armored hide glowing with the colors of the northern lights, wings blotting the sky. [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a settling wide frame as the wyvern, with a deafening bellow, rakes down and hooks the lunging orca out of the chase, hauling it clear of the broken ice; the puffin remains motionless in amazement, tiny and unharmed amid the debris, while mist curls upward where the creature's blazing breath touches the frigid sea, steam rising through the cold air.

overall_soundscape: Wind hisses across the ice while the sheet creaks and groans under the puffin's tottering steps. The frozen layer explodes in a sharp crack of shattering ice and heavy spray, followed by a deafening wyvern bellow, the rush of vast wings, and the soft hiss of steam rising off the frigid sea.
